msg: Hey, I'm a certified diver and I'd love to do a night dive. Is that possible? How much?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes! A night dive is a fantastic way to experience the reef. The one-day package includes two daytime dives and one night dive; there’s also a two-day package with four daytime dives. From Cartagena, the one-day option requires an overnight stay on the islands, and lodging isn’t included. If you’re already on the islands, the packages are available without lunch included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: From Cartagena. I'm Canadian, Advanced Open Water, last dive 6 months ago. Just me, next Tuesday.
reply:
Perfect! Your Advanced Open Water certification and recent dive history are a great fit for the night dive. Since you’re already planning the one-day Fun Dives trip from Cartagena, that plan includes two guided dives, but not a night dive.

The night-dive option is a one-day package with two daytime dives and one night dive. It requires staying overnight on the islands, and accommodation isn’t included. The meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. The next Tuesday is November 10; I can’t confirm availability for a specific date here. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check that date and help with the night-dive booking?

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
